plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
inputs: OpenVibe.Sources items (category news) via the Events subscriptions sources.item.* and sources.fetch.failed (created in production 2026-09-23) and a cursor pull; every Sources seed is disabled, so no item has arrived yet (181 empty ingest runs, 0 source items)
ai: optional seam (news.summarize_story, news.compare_perspectives) tested against a mock; not configured in production (OV_AI_INTERNAL_URL unset); OpenVibe.AI output only ever lands as a draft that needs a person's review
seed: topics only (12 in production); no stories, source items or clusters
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy news`: unit openvibe-news, 127.0.0.1:4820 loopback only; on 2026-09-23 /api/ready answered 200 and the production database held 12 topics and 0 stories. Deployed internally, not launched: openvibe.news still serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder until a person verifies a news source's terms, enables it in Sources, and an editor publishes a reviewed story
features: Sources ingestion by Events subscription and cursor pull, with dedupe
deterministic, explained clusters with audited merge and split
stories whose paragraphs cite Sources items; no publish without sources
revisions, corrections, timelines, perspectives and final retractions
licensing limits on stored and shown text
optional OpenVibe.AI drafts that need a person's review
server-rendered editorial and public pages useful without JavaScript
SDK outbox events and Search index documents
